arguments.code:
# Step: fetch all playlist song IDs (public+private), then determine which songs have genre 'reggae', and collect their artist IDs.

# Login
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); spotify_pw = next(x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='spotify')
login_res = apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
token = login_res['access_token']

# Get current following artists
following_artist_ids = set()
page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    print('following_artists page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        following_artist_ids.add(a['artist_id'])
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print('following_artist_ids_count', len(following_artist_ids))

# Fetch playlists from library

def fetch_playlists(is_public):
    playlist_entries=[]
    page_index=0; page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        print('playlists is_public', is_public, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
        if not page:
            break
        playlist_entries.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return playlist_entries

pub_entries = fetch_playlists(True)
priv_entries = fetch_playlists(False)
all_entries = pub_entries + priv_entries
print('total_playlists', len(all_entries))

# Collect unique song ids from all playlists
song_ids=set()
for pl in all_entries:
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
        song_ids.add(sid)
print('unique_song_ids_in_playlists', len(song_ids))
print('song_ids_sample', sorted(song_ids)[:30])

# Determine reggae songs and collect artist ids
reggae_song_ids=set(); reggae_artist_ids=set()
reggae_song_examples=[]

for sid in sorted(song_ids):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = song.get('genre', '')
    if isinstance(genre, str):
        genre_norm = genre.strip().lower()
    else:
        genre_norm = ''
    is_reggae = (genre_norm == 'reggae')
    if is_reggae:
        reggae_song_ids.add(sid)
        for ar in song.get('artists', []):
            reggae_artist_ids.add(ar['id'])
        if len(reggae_song_examples) < 5:
            reggae_song_examples.append({
                'song_id': sid,
                'title': song.get('title'),
                'genre': genre,
                'artists': [{'id': ar['id'], 'name': ar['name']} for ar in song.get('artists', [])]
            })

print('reggae_song_ids_count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_artist_ids_count', len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('reggae_song_examples', reggae_song_examples)

# Compare to current following
already_following_reggae = reggae_artist_ids & following_artist_ids
need_follow_reggae = reggae_artist_ids - following_artist_ids
print('already_following_reggae_count', len(already_following_reggae))
print('need_follow_reggae_count', len(need_follow_reggae))
print('need_follow_reggae_sample', sorted(list(need_follow_reggae))[:30])
